brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: Üç yönün hiçbiri kalite kapısını geçmedi (en iyi glaze ortalama 5,62, eleştirmen sunulmaz dedi), bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve gallery adımları çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Maker Chop
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 camera lens/target; s6 power/recycle/gear ring; s7 fingerprint (biometric UI icon); s4 K node tile duplicates glaze s8; s1-s3 dice/faces/blobs. No pick bettable at 7+. Direction dropped.

concepts.title: The Opening
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 magnet/horseshoe on a bar; s6 target/bullseye/eye; s7 Hangul letter or shelf-stack glyph; s8 parentheses in an app tile. All struck: cliche or wrong letter. Direction dropped.

concepts.title: Two Glazes
readsAs: rewind / skip-back media glyph (|< plus chevron)
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 dripping tile/cloud; s7 heavy K with a ball on the leg (drop); s8 K in app tile (generic, collides with chop s4). Pick s7: only one ownable, 1-colour-safe, 16px-legible. Risk: ball may read as molecule/pin; make the drop a true falling teardrop, offset from the leg, tighten stem/arm junction, drop the second colour reliance.
